description_en: Call the UpdateApp API to update Elasticsearch Serverless application information, such as remarks, network settings, IP address whitelist groups, and account passwords
description_zh: 调用UpdateApp接口，更新Elasticsearch Serverless应用相关信息，包括备注、网络开关、IP白名单组、账号密码等
kebab_example: aliyun es-serverless update-app --app-name test --description test --network '[{"port":9200,"domain":"test-123.serverless.cn-hangzhou.elasticsearch.aliyuncs.com","whiteIpGroup":[{"groupName":"default","ips":["127.0.0.1"]}],"type":"PUBLIC_ES","enabled":true}]' --authentication '{"basicAuth":[{"password":"000000","username":"test-123"}]}' --private-network '[{"vpcId":"vpc-bp1jy348ibzulk6hn0000","whiteIpGroup":[{"groupName":"default","ips":["127.0.0.1"]}],"type":"PRIVATE_ES","enabled":true,"pvlEndpointId":"ep-bp1id41dd116e52e0000"}]' --limiter-info '{"limiters":[{"minValue":3,"maxValue":1,"values":["true"],"type":"MAX_CU_PER_SHARD"}]}' --apply-reason Apply_for_system_limits. --contact-info 13702470000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateApp
